# Synthetic Korean RAG evaluation corpus

Original synthetic text under the repository license. 40 cases: 30 Workspace / 10 Ask. First 10 are calibration candidates; remaining 30 are regression cases. Labels are proposed and require human review; no human calibration is claimed.

Gold labels reference source quotes, never chunk UUIDs. The restricted document exists with an explicit grant to another principal. The long document exercises direct context packing and is excluded from Workspace users.
